title: Mindfulness-Based Intervention for Social Skills in Children with ASD
abstract: This study investigates the effects of a breathing and body scan mindfulness intervention on social skills in children aged 8-12 with Autism Spectrum Disorder. The intervention includes daily breathing exercises and weekly body scan sessions.

title: Child-Led Mindfulness Movement for Peer Interaction
abstract: An investigation into child-led mindful movement practices to enhance peer interaction and group play skills in children with ASD. The program emphasizes autonomous participation and peer-guided activities.

title: Mindful Eating Intervention for Emotional Regulation in ASD
abstract: This study explores the impact of mindful eating practices on emotional regulation and reduction of tantrum behaviors in adolescents with ASD.
